title: Understanding Principal Components
text: Principal components are directions in the data that maximize variance. PC $$1$$ captures the most variance, while PC $$2$$ captures the next most, orthogonal to PC $$1$$. Think about how these directions relate to the data's spread.

title: Slope of PC $$2$$
text: The slope of PC $$2$$ is determined by the direction it points in the data space. Consider how the slope relates to the ratio of the changes in the variables.

title: Identifying the Correct Equation
text: Which equation represents a line with a negative slope, indicating a decrease in one variable as the other increases?
